findings.problem: Process entry marked listen failure unsuccessful but did not close the acquired server/resources.
findings.change: Extract a lifecycle owner into startup.ts; await its single-flight close operation on startup failure and preserve the primary startup error. index.ts retains dotenv loading and invokes startApi.
findings.limit: Factory failure cleanup remains owned by createServer when no instance was returned. No live DB/provider shutdown proof added.

findings.problem: Independent once listeners could invoke close twice for SIGINT/SIGTERM and leave the other listener attached; a repeat of the same signal had no owned handler during cleanup.
findings.change: Retain owned on listeners while closing, share one close promise and remove only the exact owned callbacks when cleanup settles. Return an idempotent close owner for programmatic use; failures log/set runtime.exitCode and settle after cleanup.
findings.limit: Programmatic callers must use the returned owner; directly closing a separately held Fastify instance bypasses this ownership wrapper. No removeAllListeners, forced process.exit or force-kill policy added.

findings.problem: Signals while the factory was pending had no lifecycle owner; a signal during listen could still be followed by a success announcement.
findings.change: Attach handlers before awaiting the factory, remember shutdown intent, close a subsequently returned instance without listening, and suppress success logging once shutdown starts.
findings.limit: This records shutdown intent; it does not cancel an unresolved factory, enforce a shutdown deadline or guarantee a successful exit if listen itself rejects during concurrent shutdown.

review.dependency_trace: Re-read process entry and server-factory return/cleanup; inspected installed Fastify addHook/onClose implementation and token-blacklist import-time unref timer. Existing server-bootstrap suite revalidated. Complete container/module/DB/provider graph is not reviewed in this task.
review.preserved: Bind host :: and configured port; factory dependency and dotenv import ordering; startup/close failure exit code 1; existing failure exit state retained on success; no immediate process.exit. Close errors still log and set failure status.
review.ownership: Each invocation owns only its callback references. Repeated requests return the same promise. The returned close handle owns signal cleanup; lifecycle calls before instance acquisition defer shutdown until the factory settles.
